statement:
∀ (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ZMod m),
  let H : Matrix (DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (DirichletCharacter ℂ m) ℂ := fun χ ψ =>
    (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ (N - (x : ZMod m))) / (m.totient : ℂ)
  H.IsHermitian ∧ ∀ (s : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)) (v : DirichletCharacter ℂ m → ℂ),
    (∑ χ ∈ s, ‖∑ ψ ∈ s, H χ ψ * v ψ‖^2) ≤ ∑ χ ∈ s, ‖v χ‖^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0006 · 在任意特征子集上核对反射矩阵的自伴和范数
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0006 · Verify the character reflection matrix is Hermitian and contractive on any character subset

brief.zh: 在单位余类上使用 φ(m) 的平方根归一化。先将特征向量零延拓，再用反射的部分置换和有限 Parseval。该范数界控制 DR-0016、DR-0018 的两种替换。
brief.en: Normalize characters by the square root of φ(m). Extend the coefficient vector by zero and use the partial permutation and finite Parseval. DR-0016 and DR-0018 use this bound for their replacements.
